title: Public Website Development Begins
summary: The first public frontend for Humanities & Social Sciences Alive is being developed with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and reusable mock data.
body: The website introduces the platform's courses, research, workshops, events, news, and contact workflows. The current release uses static JSON data so future backend services can be integrated without redesigning the user experience.

title: Course Roadmap Announced
summary: The first learning catalogue includes English language, literature, public speaking, ICT, research fundamentals, and school subject support.
body: The roadmap begins with foundational English and research courses, then expands into subject-focused learning for history, geography, civics, economics, and professional development.

title: Research Desk Planned
summary: A research desk will support project briefs, reading lists, publication workflows, and collaborative inquiry.
body: The research desk is planned as a bridge between public academic resources and future editorial workflows for publications, downloads, and student research support.

title: Workshop Series Preview
summary: Upcoming workshops focus on research proposals, public speaking, critical reading, and professional skills.
body: The workshop series is designed for practical learning with live feedback and clear outcomes. Registration flows are currently UI-only and ready for backend integration.
